headline: As of 2026-11-03: 61,552,157 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 61,552,157 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,884,552), Florida (6,812,870), California (6,481,962).
